info.name: PizzaHub - Customer Orders API tests
info.description: See docs/CUSTOMER_ORDERS_TESTING.md. Run the folders top to bottom, in a fresh Postman session, against a demo database (not your real one).

item.name: 2. Setup (customers, vendor, an approved and a pending item)
Set a new runId and delivery days
Customer One: sign up (ok if the user already exists)

exec: pm.test("signed up, or the user already exists", () => pm.expect([200, 400, 409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test("token received", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("customerToken", t); });

request.description: Uses the session cookie stored by the sign-in request right above it.

item.name: Admin: sign in (account made by `npm run seed:admin`)

exec: pm.test("token received", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("adminToken", t); });

pm.test("success, pending, with item and vendor info", () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.equal(true); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.equal("pending"); pm.expect(b.data.item).to.have.property("itemName"); pm.expect(b.data.vendor).to.have.property("name"); });
pm.test("no customerId / vendorId in the response", () => { pm.expect("customerId" in b.data).to.equal(false); pm.expect("vendorId" in b.data).to.equal(false); });

item.name: Customer 2 orders the same item and day
Extra fields (customerId, vendorId, status) are refused

exec: pm.test("2 orders, newest first, pagination", () => { pm.expect(b.data.length).to.equal(2); pm.expect(b.data[0]._id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get("order2Id")); pm.expect(b.pagination.totalItems).to.equal(2); });

pm.test("1 order on page 2, no next page", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.length).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.pagination.totalPages).to.equal(2); pm.expect(b.pagination.hasNextPage).to.equal(false); });
